task.source_name: Ripple issue-linked change dataset (record instance-00010; used for candidate discovery and cross-check only)
task.issue_text_source: ASF Jira REST API v2 issue IVY-1028 fields created,summary,description; timestamp and original request checked 2026-10-25; https://issues.apache.org/jira/rest/api/2/issue/IVY-1028?fields=created,summary,description
task.selection_decision: Selected for a one-task pilot after verifying the official Jira creation timestamp precedes the target, the target's first parent equals the recorded parent, and the complete parent-to-target Git diff path set. Evaluation label is every changed path in the target patch, including CHANGES.txt; Ripple impact-set-files is separately recorded metadata and is not used as ground truth.
cleaning_decisions: Use original issue summary plus cleaned opening technical problem statement; omit quoted mail headers, contact addresses, and follow-up discussion.
Ground truth is exact Git diff path set from parent to target; do not substitute Ripple impact-set-files.
No target diff/body, commit message, changed paths, or post-target repository content is included in predictor input.

allowed: candidate paths selected from the parent tree
predictor_input_policy.constraint_type: candidate-list prompt constraint; strict validation still enforced after generation

baselines.seed_selection: first deterministic lexical source rank from request text against parent snapshot

predictions.rationale: The change involves modifying the java.net resolver to use the maven2 of download.java.net and adding m2compatible and usepoms=true. This change is likely to impact the IBiblioResolver, as it handles the resolution of dependencies from the ibiblio repository.

The ResolveEngine is responsible for driving the resolution process. Changes to the resolver configuration, such as adding m2compatible and usepoms, may affect how the ResolveEngine handles dependency resolution.
IvyNode represents a node in the dependency graph. Changes to the resolver configuration might affect how IvyNode handles dependencies, especially when dealing with snapshot versions.
VisitNode is used to visit nodes during the resolution process. Changes to the resolver configuration might affect how VisitNode processes nodes, particularly when dealing with snapshot versions.
RepositoryCacheManager manages the cache for repository artifacts. Changes to the resolver configuration might affect how artifacts are cached, especially when dealing with snapshot versions.
PomModuleDescriptorBuilder is responsible for building module descriptors from Maven POM files. Changes to the resolver configuration might affect how POM files are parsed and processed.
BasicResolver is a base class for resolvers. Changes to the resolver configuration might affect how BasicResolver handles dependency resolution.
ModuleDescriptor represents a module descriptor. Changes to the resolver configuration might affect how module descriptors are created and used.
ChainResolver chains multiple resolvers together. Changes to the resolver configuration might affect how ChainResolver handles dependency resolution.
ResolveOptions provides options for the resolution process. Changes to the resolver configuration might affect how ResolveOptions are used.

limitations: One task and one model call are a pilot only, not conclusive evidence.
Changed-path labels are not a complete oracle for every file potentially affected.
Issue cleaning decisions are recorded in the task manifest.
C0_CONSTRAINED is a candidate-list prompt condition, not a hard decoding constraint; invalid paths are still rejected.
